findings.description: The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration. Objects such as the customer-master spreadsheet are therefore not explicitly protected by a bucket encryption policy, allowing unencrypted-at-rest storage where upload behavior or account defaults do not provide encryption.
The financials bucket does not configure default server-side encryption. Financial data placed in this bucket is not explicitly required to be encrypted at rest.
The operations bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Versioning does not encrypt object contents, so stored operational data lacks an explicit encryption-at-rest control.

The data science bucket does not configure default server-side encryption. Its logging configuration does not protect the bucket's own object data from being stored without an explicit encryption-at-rest requirement.
